title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether Arbitral Awards Made by Chinese Arbitration Institutions May Be Partially Revoked

articles.content_en:
The Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province:

Your Court's Request for Instructions No. (1997) Yue Fa Jing Er Qing Zi No. 22, "The Request for Instructions on the Application of Shenzhen Ruifeng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd. for Setting Aside Award No. (97) Shen Guo Zhong Jie Zi No. 07," has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:

If the matters arbitrated in an arbitration award rendered by a Chinese arbitration institution exceed the scope agreed upon in the parties' arbitration agreement, or are not within the matters submitted by the parties for arbitration, and if such matters are severable from the other matters on which the arbitration institution made the award, the People's Court may, upon the application of a party, rule to set aside such exceeded part after ascertaining the facts. With respect to the Request for Instructions No. (1997) Yue Fa Jing Er Qing Zi No. 22 by your Court, the majority opinion of the Adjudication Committee of your Court is agreed, i.e., the third item of Award No. (97) Shen Guo Zhong Jie Zi No. 07 rendered by the Shenzhen Sub-Commission of the China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission constitutes a dispute under the lease contract, not a dispute under the cooperation contract. Given that the lease contract contains no arbitration clause, upon the application of Shenzhen Ruifeng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd., the People's Court may rule to set aside that part of the arbitration award.

This is the reply.
